name: Uncomfortably Exciting
definition: Success requires us to be bold and ambitious, to think differently, experiment and adapt (often quickly). This is true whether we're designing a new product feature, working to improve our recommendations, developing a marketing campaign or creating a TV show or game. Many people will be happier at companies that are more stable or take fewer risks. Netflix works best if you value experimentation, enjoy the uncomfortable excitement of a new or challenging project and have the resilience to thrive in this environment.

rows.situation: A bold version and a version that cannot fail visibly
rows.under: Picks the safe one by default.
rows.justRight: Picks the bold one when the ambition is real, and designs the experiment so a failure teaches you something.
rows.over: Picks the bold one with no way to learn, and no owner for the downside.

rows.situation: Trying something members, viewers, or players will actually meet
rows.under: Either never experiments, or experiments casually with no read on what happened.
rows.justRight: Tries it, watches the result, and adapts quickly.
rows.over: Runs so many experiments that nobody can tell which change did what.

rows.situation: An experiment that is not working
rows.under: Lets it run because changing course admits the bet was uncomfortable.
rows.justRight: Adapts as soon as the result is clear, and keeps the ambition even when you drop the method.
rows.over: Kills the ambition at the first uncomfortable week.

rows.situation: A person who wants stable work and few risks
rows.under: Talks them into staying by pretending the work will calm down.
rows.justRight: Tells them the truth about the place. Helps them succeed if they want this, and does not pretend it will become a calm job.
rows.over: Treats a preference for stability as a character flaw and says so in public.

rows.under: Avoids it, or seeks the feeling and forgets the aim.
rows.justRight: Stays with the discomfort when it is the price of a better result, and drops it when it is only drama.
rows.over: Adds stress, secrecy, or chaos so the work feels important.
